name: Alt Serin
description: This patch replaces Serin's sprite and portrait with the one from the previous versions.

name: Alt Tifa
description: This patch simply changes Tifa to an alternate-colored hair Tifa sprite.

name: Apple Knight Arc
description: This patch changes Arc's Onion Knight sprite and portrait to that of a healthy green apple! His class name however will remain 'Onion Knight', due to the dialog.

name: Archbishop Astral
description: This patch changes Astral's Wizard-looking sprite and portrait into that of a holy Bishop.

name: Buccaneer Otis
description: This patch changes Otis's sprite and portrait to a more buccaneer-styled pirate.

name: Classic Eiko
description: This patch replaces the default Record Keeper Eiko's sprite with the previous version/older 'classic' Eiko sprite made by Poco Loco oh so long ago.

name: Classic Golbez
description: This patch changes Golbez's sprite and portrait to a much more FF4 variation.

name: Cowgirl Tifa
description: This patch changes Tifa's sprite and portrait to her western cowgirl attire from her younger days in FF7.

name: Crisis Core Cloud
description: This patch changes Clouds's sprite and portrait to that of his Crisis Core attire.

name: Dancer Mog
description: This patch changes Mog's sprite and portrait to another version: Dancer Mog! This will of course change every other Moogle sprite in the game as well, because they all share the same sprite ID. All the playable moogles' portraits have been updated to match as well.

name: Dark Esper Aurora
description: This patch changes Aurora's palette back to the pre-version 2.9 palette, where she has dark hair and dress.

name: Dark Hair Ronan
description: This patch simply changes Ronan's red hair back to how it was in previous versions (black/grey), with red on his pants.

name: Defender Heartless
description: This patch changes Shadow the Heartless's sprite and portrait to a bigger, evolved form of sorts, called a Defender, which is also from the Kingdom Hearts universe.

name: Dragoon Otis
description: This patch changes Otis to an alternate Dragoon sprite and portrait.

name: Engineer Serin
description: This patch changes Serin's sprite and portrait to an engineer reminiscent of Cid from FFIV, with a touch of Mega Man.

name: Ffv Pig Status
description: This patch changes the pig sprite back to the previous (FFV) version.

name: Havoc Knight Avalon
description: This patch changes Avalon's sprite and portrait to that of a fully armored Shovel Knight-looking badass: Havoc Knight Avalon!

name: Hitman Oboro
description: This patch changes Oboro's sprite and portrait to a version reminiscent of Hitman (bald with a suit).

name: Invisible Heartless
description: This patch changes Shadow the Heartless's sprite and portrait to a much more intimidating version that is the dreaded Invisible, also from the Kingdom Hearts universe.

name: Lich Form Reaper
description: This patch changes Reapers's sprite and portrait to another version: Lich-form Reaper.

name: Master Monk Ronan
description: This patch changes Ronan's sprite and portrait to another version: Master Ronan! Basically he resembles more a Kung Fu master, which is pretty awesome.

name: Miko Eiko
description: This patch changes Eiko's sprite and portrait to that of a Japanaese 'shrine maiden', called a Miko.

name: Mist Demon Avalon
description: This patch changes Avalon's sprite and portrait to a mistly demon-like form, with horns, wings, and claws akin to that of a dragon.

name: Piglet Status
description: This patch changes the Pig Status sprite and portrait to that of an awfully cute quadrupedal piglet!

name: Pumpkin Arc
description: This patch changes Arc's Onion Knight sprite and portrait to that of a familiar spooky orange squash: Pumpkin Knight Arc! His class name however will remain 'Onion Knight', due to the character length and dialog.

name: Royal Serin
description: This patch changes Serin's sprite and portrait to that fitting of a true king!

name: Sorceress Aurora
description: This patch changes Aurora's sprite and portrait to another version: Sorceress Aurora! She dons a beautiful FF8 Sorceress-inspired garment.

name: Summoner Eiko
description: This patch changes Eiko's sprite and portrait to a different more FFX Summoner look.

name: Terminator Leo
description: This patch changes General Leo's sprite and portrait to that akin of a full-blown T-800 Terminator!

name: Younger Fusoya
description: This patch changes Fusoya's sprite and portrait to what one might imagine Fusoya to look like in his not so old/middle-aged prime, which would still be incredible old compared to our feeble human lifespans!
